evidence: Genesis 10:13 and 1 Chronicles 1:11 identify Ludim among the descendants of Mizraim (Egypt).
Genesis 10:22 and 1 Chronicles 1:17 separately identify Lud among the sons of Shem.
The current BRSI person:Lud record explicitly has father person:Shem, whereas the inherited group:Ludim group_origin points to person:Lud.

International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, 'Lud; Ludim', explicitly distinguishes these two genealogical claims (https://www.bibletools.org/index.cfm/fuseaction/Def.show/RTD/ISBE/ID/5604/Lud-Ludim.htm).
editorial_field_changes.reason: The inherited group_origin unconditionally identifies the Egyptian Ludim descendants of Mizraim with the distinct Lud, son of Shem. Remove only this unsupported genealogical identity edge; do not assert a new group origin, merge original-word mentions, or decide disputed later ethnic identifications.

bsi.editorial_reason: Genesis 10:13 / 1 Chronicles 1:11 attribute Ludim to Mizraim, not to the person Lud who is named as son of Shem in Genesis 10:22 / 1 Chronicles 1:17.
